exact_blockers: The exact Hush source revision, ONNX bundle and platform runtime libraries are pinned by SHA-256 from the external research checkout, but no caller-supplied asset manifest or copy exists in this SDK worktree; the exact runtime cannot be loaded or reproduced here.

Hush source and model card declare Apache-2.0, but artifact-specific model-bundle and runtime redistribution/product-use rights, the upstream distribution channel (a placeholder release URL) and training-data provenance are not established, and no legal review exists. No asset was downloaded, copied, built, vendored or redistributed.

Only a deterministic model-free boundary surrogate was executed. It is not Hush, has no ONNX graph, DeepFilterNet blocks or weights, and its synthetic two-source target/leakage numbers are boundary-conformance observations, not a quality, room, listening, device-timing or benchmark result.

No rights-cleared held-out spatial cohort with speaker/room labels, no enrollment-conditioned extraction, no independent listening, no target-runtime timing/memory, no opt-in provider intake, no descriptor/registry review and no public default decision exist; every release gate remains blocked.
